source_en: Home from school on Lenina Street.
Home to Mom with a shiny stone.
Getting my lost toy back.
School let out early. Black rain.
Home. Only four came to school.
Hiding from the black rain.
The census hall wrote my name.
Home to Mom and my dolls.
Doing the youth census.
Off my tram depot night shift.
Picking up my son from kindergarten.
Driving home. Car's by the gate.
Back from university. Exams next week.
Called in for the factory night shift.
Collecting my driving licence.
Going home. Dolls are for babies.
Off duty from counting census names.
Taking my grandkids home before curfew.
Hello. My mom said I have to show you this paper.
I found a shiny stone in the dirt. Want to see?
Why is your shadow so much longer than you, mister?
The swings move with no wind. The buildings whisper they're cold.
I'm playing hide and seek with the sun. I think I won.
My dolls say it's time to go into the big sleep.
Thank you. I'm going to see my mom now.
Don't let the bad air bite you, mister.
I'll close my eyes at home. It's prettier.
Am I in trouble? I don't think I broke anything.
I'll be very quiet. I've been practicing.
I didn't do anything wrong… I was just standing here…
It's getting dark… can someone… tell my mom?
Where are you coming from?
School on Lenina Street. Lots of empty desks today.
School. Only four of us came. The rain was black.
The census hall. A lady wrote my dolls' names too.
School on Pushkin Street. It's always very quiet there.
Papa's flat. I live with him on weekdays now.
Work. I help at the bread factory. I'm fifteen.
Nowhere. I've always been here. Haven't I always been here?
The place with the long shadow. It sent me to you.
I didn't come. I just… arrived. Like the ash does.
Are you experiencing any symptoms?
No. Loud noises hurt my ears. Holding still helps.
My tummy hurts at night. Mom blames the soup. No fever.
I'm sleepy all the time. My dolls say everybody is now.
No. I love loud noises. The louder the better!
Nothing hurts. Mom and Dad both checked me this morning.
Not sleepy. And I'm too old for dolls and pretend.
My skin feels like it belongs to someone bigger.
Sometimes my hands aren't mine. I put them away then.
I don't feel anything anymore. Is that bad? It's bad.
Your hat is very big. Does it fall over your eyes?
Is it always this loud? The city is thinking very hard.
The swings near my building move when there's no wind.
The buildings are whispering. They're cold. They want blankets.
My dolls told me to be polite to the officer. So. Hello.
Is today going to stay forever, or is tomorrow still coming?
